Description: The nacelle design shall provide adequate access for inspection and maintenance of all serviceable components.
Acceptance_Criteria: All inspection points accessible per MSG-3 tasks

Description: Line replaceable units (LRUs) shall be replaceable within specified maintenance times using standard tools.
Acceptance_Criteria: LRU replacement ≤2 manhours; special tools minimized

Description: Inspection panels shall provide visual and NDI access to critical structure and be removable without special tooling.
Acceptance_Criteria: Panel removal ≤5 minutes; reinstall with standard fasteners

Description: Approved repair schemes shall be available for field-repairable damage to nacelle structure per SRM requirements.
Acceptance_Criteria: SRM coverage for common damage scenarios

Description: Nacelle structural maintenance intervals shall be defined based on MSG-3 analysis and damage tolerance assessment.
Acceptance_Criteria: Maintenance intervals ≥4C check for major inspections
